description: This file defines the interface for managing OCI (Open Container Initiative) containers within the WPEFramework. It includes enums for container states, notification callbacks for container events, and pure virtual functions for container operations such as start, stop, pause, resume, Hibernate, Wakeup, execute commands, and manage properties.

classes.name: IOCIContainer
classes.description: An interface class for managing container lifecycle and operations in the WPEFramework, supporting events and commands related to container states.

classes.name: IOCIContainer::INotification
classes.description: A nested interface for receiving notifications about container lifecycle events such as start, stop, failure, and state changes.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Register a notification callback for container events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregister a previously registered notification callback.

methods.name: ListContainers
methods.description: Retrieve a list of existing containers with an indication of success and potential error message.

methods.name: GetContainerInfo
methods.description: Fetch detailed information about a specific container.

methods.name: GetContainerState
methods.description: Obtain the current state of a container.

methods.name: StartContainer
methods.description: Start a container from a specified bundle path, optionally with a command and Westeros socket.

methods.name: StartContainerFromDobbySpec
methods.description: Start a container based on a dobby specification JSON, with optional command and socket.

methods.name: StopContainer
methods.description: Stop a running container, optionally forcefully.

methods.name: PauseContainer
methods.description: Pause a running container.

methods.name: ResumeContainer
methods.description: Resume a paused container.

methods.name: HibernateContainer
methods.description: Hibernate a container with optional options.

methods.name: WakeupContainer
methods.description: Wake up a hibernated container.

methods.name: ExecuteCommand
methods.description: Execute a command inside a container with optional parameters.

methods.name: Annotate
methods.description: Add or update a property annotation on a container.

methods.name: RemoveAnnotation
methods.description: Remove a property annotation from a container.

methods.name: Mount
methods.description: Mount a filesystem path into the container.

methods.name: Unmount
methods.description: Unmount a filesystem path from the container.

methods.name: void OnContainerFailed(const string & containerId,const string & name,uint32_t error)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: void OnContainerStarted(const string & containerId,const string & name)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: void OnContainerStateChanged(const string & containerId,ContainerState state)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: void OnContainerStopped(const string & containerId,const string & name)
methods.description: unavailable
